note: DAN.1.20-21, ten times better than the magicians, and Daniel remains in service. This is the same hall as scene 8, but later: the formal presentation on the mid-hall runner is over, so this scene works closer to the throne and among the flanking cedar columns rather than at the south door. Daniel stands nearest the dais, the household's usual place having settled into an actual position of favor. The court magician is placed on the aisle between the spawn and Daniel so the player passes the comparison the verse makes on the way to seeing its outcome. The messenger is caught mid-errand in the open aisle; the junior scribe works back among the rear columns, away from the throne. Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah are spread at different depths among the columns rather than grouped. The Prophets and Wisdom guides stand near the dais end, echoing the magicians' comeuppance and Daniel's excess of insight; the History guide sits mid-hall near the court-records beat in Hananiah's dialogue.

exit.note: the south door, same physical exit as scene 8; the end-of-chapter close-out is phase 5's job
